shipping.question: How long does shipping take?
shipping.answer: Delivery times vary by location. For Casablanca, orders are typically delivered within 24-48 hours. For other cities in Morocco, delivery takes 2-5 business days.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We currently accept Cash on Delivery (COD) only. Pay cash when you receive your order.

tracking.question: How can I track my order?
tracking.answer: Once your order is shipped, you'll receive a tracking number via SMS and email. You can use this number to track your order status on our website.

delivery.question: Do you deliver to all cities in Morocco?
delivery.answer: Yes! We deliver to all cities and regions across Morocco. Shipping is always free.

cod.question: Is cash on delivery available?
cod.answer: Yes, cash on delivery (COD) is available for all orders within Morocco. You can pay in cash when you receive your order.

guarantee.question: What is your quality guarantee?
guarantee.answer: We guarantee the quality of all our products. If you're not satisfied with the product quality, you can contact us within the specified guarantee period and we'll resolve the issue.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect and use your personal data
privacy.description: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information
privacy.introduction: We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website.

collection.title: Information Collection
collection.content: We collect information you provide when placing an order, including name, phone number, and address. We use this information only to process and deliver your order.

usage.title: Information Usage
usage.content: We use your information to process orders, communicate with you about your order, and improve our services. We will not share your information with third parties without your consent.

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with delivery partners only to complete your order.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to improve your experience on our website. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about our Privacy Policy, please contact us.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: Terms of use for our website and services
terms.description: Read the terms and conditions for using Marka Tools
terms.introduction: By using our website and services, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

orders.title: Orders & Purchases
orders.content: When placing an order, you agree to provide accurate and complete information. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order for any reason.

payment.title: Payment
payment.content: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD) only. Full payment in cash must be made upon receiving your order. All prices are in Moroccan Dirham (MAD).

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.content: We do our best to deliver within the expected time, but delivery times are estimates and cannot be guaranteed. You are responsible for receiving the order at the provided address.

liability.title: Liability
liability.content: We are responsible for the quality of products provided. If there is any defect in the product upon delivery, please contact us immediately.

terms.contactText: If you have any questions about these terms, please contact us.

cookies.description: Learn about our use of cookies
cookies.introduction: We use cookies to improve your experience on our website. This policy explains what cookies are and how we use them.

what.title: What are Cookies?
what.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. These files help us remember your preferences and improve your experience.

types.title: Types of Cookies
types.content: We use necessary cookies to operate the website and analytical cookies to understand how visitors use the site.

purpose.title: Purpose of Use
purpose.content: We use cookies to remember your shopping cart, language preferences, and to analyze website traffic.

manage.title: Managing Cookies
manage.content: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may affect website functionality.

cookies.contactText: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us.
